name: Executioners Guild
text: Play the Executioners Guild if you want to strike down your targets with lethal precision.

foundation.name: First Strike
foundation.text: The first time in a scene you succeed on an attack, you deal double damage.

foundation.name: Ambush
foundation.text: Your “Marked for Death” feature uses **d6s** instead of d4s.

specialization.name: Death Strike
specialization.text: When you deal {{term:damage-thresholds|Severe damage}} to a creature, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to force them to mark an additional {{term:hit-points|Hit Point}}.

specialization.name: Scorpion’s Poise
specialization.text: You gain a +2 bonus to your {{term:evasion|Evasion}} against attacks made by a creature you’ve _Marked for_ _Death_.

mastery.name: True Strike
mastery.text: Once per {{term:long-rest|long rest}} when you fail an attack, you can **spend a {{term:hope|Hope}}** to make it a success instead.

mastery.name: Backstab
mastery.text: Your “Marked for Death” feature uses **d8s** instead of d6s.

name: Poisoners Guild
text: Play the Poisoners Guild if you want to debilitate your targets with punishing afflictions.

foundation.name: Toxic Concoctions
foundation.text:
**Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to place **1d4+1** tokens on this card. When you make a successful weapon attack, you can spend a token to afflict the target with a poison. You know these poisons:

- **_Ghost Petal:_** The target becomes {{term:temporary|temporarily}} _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_.
- **_Grave Spore:_** The target must also mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}.
- **_Leech Weed:_** You deal an extra **1d6** damage on this attack.

When you take a {{term:long-rest|long rest}}, clear all unspent tokens.

specialization.name: Poison Compendium
specialization.text:
You also know these poisons:

- **_Midnight Vine:_** The target has {{term:disadvantage|disadvantage}} on attack rolls until it marks a {{term:stress|Stress}} to clear this condition.
- **_Gorgon Root:_** The target becomes {{term:temporary|temporarily}} _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_.

specialization.name: Twin Fang
specialization.text: When you afflict a target _Marked for Death_ with a poison you know, you can spend an additional token to also inflict the effect of a second poison you know.

mastery.name: Venomancer
mastery.text:
You also know these poisons:

- **_Blight Seed:_** The target gains a −3 penalty to their {{term:damage-thresholds|damage thresholds}} until the end of the scene. This effect can’t stack.
- **_{{term:fear|Fear}} Leaf:_** You deal extra damage equal to the result of your {{term:duality-dice|Fear Die}} on this attack.
- **_Corpse Thorn:_** The target gains {{term:disadvantage|disadvantage}} on {{term:reaction-roll|reaction rolls}} until the end of the scene.

mastery.name: Adder’s Blessing
mastery.text: You are {{term:immunity|immune}} to poisons and other toxins.

name: Troubadour
text: Play the Troubadour if you want to play music to bolster your allies.

foundation.name: Gifted Performer
foundation.text:
You can play three different types of songs, once each per {{term:long-rest|long rest}}; describe how you perform for others to gain the listed benefit:

- **_Relaxing Song:_** You and all allies within {{term:close|Close range}} clear a {{term:hit-points|Hit Point}}.
- **_Epic Song:_** Make a target within {{term:close|Close range}} {{term:temporary|temporarily}} _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}._
- **_Heartbreaking Song:_** You and all allies within {{term:close|Close range}} gain a {{term:hope|Hope}}.

specialization.name: Maestro
specialization.text: Your rallying songs steel the courage of those who listen. When you give a Rally Die to an ally, they can gain a {{term:hope|Hope}} or clear a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

mastery.name: Virtuoso
mastery.text: You are among the greatest of your craft and your skill is boundless. You can perform each of your “Gifted Performer” feature’s songs twice per {{term:long-rest|long rest}}.

name: Wordsmith
text: Play the Wordsmith if you want to use clever wordplay and captivate crowds.

foundation.name: Rousing Speech
foundation.text: Once per {{term:long-rest|long rest}}, you can give a heartfelt, inspiring speech. All allies within {{term:far|Far range}} clear 2 {{term:stress|Stress}}.

foundation.name: Heart of a Poet
foundation.text: After you make an {{term:action-roll|action roll}} to impress, persuade, or offend someone, you can **spend a {{term:hope|Hope}}** to add a **d4** to the roll.

specialization.name: Eloquent
specialization.text:
Your moving words boost morale. Once per session, when you encourage an ally, you can do one of the following:

- Allow them to find a mundane object or tool they need.
- {{term:help-an-ally|Help an Ally}} without spending {{term:hope|Hope}}.
- Give them an additional {{term:downtime|downtime move}} during their next rest.

mastery.name: Epic Poetry
mastery.text: Your Rally Die increases to a **d10.** Additionally, when you {{term:help-an-ally|Help an Ally}}, you can narrate the moment as if you were writing the tale of their heroism in a memoir. When you do, roll a **d10** as your {{term:advantage|advantage}} die.

name: Juggernaut
text: Play the Juggernaut if you want to pulverize your opponents with crushing blows.

foundation.name: Rugged
foundation.text: Gain a permanent +3 bonus to your {{term:damage-thresholds|Severe damage}} threshold.

foundation.name: Overwhelm
foundation.text: When you succeed on an attack against a target, you can **spend a {{term:hope|Hope}}** to throw the target within {{term:close|Close range}} or to force them to mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

specialization.name: Surrounded
specialization.text: When you make an attack with a Melee weapon, you can **spend any number of {{term:hope|Hope}}** to target an equal number of additional creatures within {{term:melee|Melee range}}.

specialization.name: Eye for an Eye
specialization.text: Once per rest when an adversary within {{term:melee|Melee range}} forces you to mark any number of {{term:hit-points|Hit Points}}, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to force them to mark the same number of {{term:hit-points|Hit Points}}.

mastery.name: Pummeljoy
mastery.text: When you critically succeed on a Melee weapon attack, you gain an additional {{term:hope|Hope}}, clear an additional {{term:stress|Stress}}, and gain a +1 bonus to your {{term:proficiency|Proficiency}} for that attack.

mastery.name: Not Done Yet
mastery.text: When you take {{term:damage-thresholds|Severe damage}}, you can gain a {{term:hope|Hope}} or clear a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

name: Martial Artist
text: Play the Martial Artist if you want to use a variety of fighting styles to eliminate your foes.

foundation.name: Stance Fighter
foundation.text:
You can channel your inner resolve to shift into martial stances that grant you special benefits in combat.

Take the Martial Stances sheet and choose two martial stances from Tier 1. Each time you level up your character, choose an additional stance from your {{term:tier|tier}} or lower.

specialization.name: Keen Defenses
specialization.text: When you’re targeted by an attack, you can **spend a Focus** to gain a bonus to your {{term:evasion|Evasion}} equal to your {{term:tier|tier}} against the attack.

specialization.name: Focus Cannon
specialization.text: **Spend a Focus** to make an {{term:instinct|Instinct}} Roll against an adversary within {{term:far|Far range}}. On a success, deal **d20+3** magic damage using your {{term:proficiency|Proficiency}}.

mastery.name: Limit Breaker
mastery.text: Once per rest, you can perform an unbelievable feat of athletic prowess, such as running across water, leaping between distant rooftops, or scaling a building without needing to roll. When you do, gain a {{term:hope|Hope}} and clear a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

mastery.name: Flow State
mastery.text: You can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** instead of spending a Focus to shift into a different stance. Additionally, you can **spend a Focus** instead of marking a {{term:stress|Stress}} to start a combo strike.

name: Warden of the Elements
text: Play the Warden of the Elements if you want to embody the natural elements of the wild.

foundation.name: Elemental Incarnation
foundation.text:
**Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to _Channel_ one of the following elements until you take {{term:damage-thresholds|Severe damage}} or until your next rest:

- **_Fire:_** When an adversary within {{term:melee|Melee range}} deals damage to you, they take **1d10** magic damage.
- **_Earth:_** Gain a bonus to your {{term:damage-thresholds|damage thresholds}} equal to your {{term:proficiency|Proficiency}}.
- **_Water:_** When you deal damage to an adversary within {{term:melee|Melee range}}, all other adversaries within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}.
- **_Air:_** You can hover, gaining {{term:advantage|advantage}} on {{term:agility|Agility}} Rolls.

specialization.name: Elemental Aura
specialization.text:
Once per rest while _Channeling_, you can assume an aura matching your element. The aura affects targets within {{term:close|Close range}} until your _Channeling_ ends.

- **_Fire:_** When an adversary marks 1 or more {{term:hit-points|Hit Points}}, they must also mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}.
- **_Earth:_** Your allies gain a +1 bonus to {{term:strength|Strength}}.
- **_Water:_** When an adversary deals damage to you, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to move them anywhere within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} of where they are.
- **_Air:_** When you or an ally takes damage from an attack beyond {{term:melee|Melee range}}, reduce the damage by **1d8**.

mastery.name: Elemental Dominion
mastery.text:
You further embody your element. While _Channeling_, you gain the following benefit:

- **_Fire:_** You gain a +1 bonus to your {{term:proficiency|Proficiency}} for attacks and spells that deal damage.
- **_Earth:_** When you would mark {{term:hit-points|Hit Points}}, roll a **d6** per {{term:hit-points|Hit Point}} marked. For each result of 6, reduce the number of {{term:hit-points|Hit Points}} you mark by 1.
- **_Water:_** When an attack against you succeeds, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to make the attacker {{term:temporary|temporarily}} _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}}_.
- **_Air:_** You gain a +1 bonus to your {{term:evasion|Evasion}} and can fly.

name: Warden of Renewal
text: Play the Warden of Renewal if you want to use powerful magic to heal your party.

foundation.name: Clarity of Nature
foundation.text: Once per {{term:long-rest|long rest}}, you can create a space of natural serenity within {{term:close|Close range}}. When you spend a few minutes resting within the space, clear {{term:stress|Stress}} equal to your {{term:instinct|Instinct}}, distributed as you choose between you and your allies.

foundation.name: Regeneration
foundation.text: Touch a creature and **spend 3 {{term:hope|Hope}}.** That creature clears **1d4** {{term:hit-points|Hit Points}}.

specialization.name: Regenerative Reach
specialization.text: You can target creatures within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} with your “Regeneration” feature.

specialization.name: Warden’s Protection
specialization.text: Once per {{term:long-rest|long rest}}, **spend 2 {{term:hope|Hope}}** to clear 2 {{term:hit-points|Hit Points}} on **1d4** allies within {{term:close|Close range}}.

mastery.name: Defender
mastery.text: Your animal transformation embodies a healing guardian spirit. When you’re in Beastform and an ally within {{term:close|Close range}} marks 2 or more {{term:hit-points|Hit Points}}, you can **mark a** **{{term:stress|Stress}}** to reduce the number of {{term:hit-points|Hit Points}} they mark by 1.

name: Stalwart
text: Play the Stalwart if you want to take heavy blows and keep fighting.

foundation.name: Unwavering
foundation.text: Gain a permanent +1 bonus to your {{term:damage-thresholds|damage thresholds}}.

foundation.name: Iron Will
foundation.text: When you take physical damage, you can **mark an** **additional {{term:armor-slot|Armor Slot}}** to reduce the severity.

specialization.name: Unrelenting
specialization.text: Gain a permanent +2 bonus to your {{term:damage-thresholds|damage thresholds}}.

specialization.name: Partners-in-Arms
specialization.text: When an ally within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} takes damage, you can **mark an {{term:armor-slot|Armor Slot}}** to reduce the severity by one threshold.

mastery.name: Undaunted
mastery.text: Gain a permanent +3 bonus to your {{term:damage-thresholds|damage thresholds}}.

mastery.name: Loyal Protector
mastery.text: When an ally within {{term:close|Close range}} has 2 or fewer {{term:hit-points|Hit Points}} and would take damage, you can **mark a** **{{term:stress|Stress}}** to sprint to their side and take the damage instead.

name: Vengeance
text: Play the Vengeance if you want to strike down enemies who harm you or your allies.

foundation.name: At Ease
foundation.text: Gain an additional {{term:stress|Stress}} slot.

foundation.name: Revenge
foundation.text: When an adversary within {{term:melee|Melee range}} succeeds on an attack against you, you can **mark 2 {{term:stress|Stress}}** to force the attacker to mark a {{term:hit-points|Hit Point}}.

specialization.name: Act of Reprisal
specialization.text: When an adversary damages an ally within {{term:melee|Melee range}}, you gain a +1 bonus to your {{term:proficiency|Proficiency}} for the next successful attack you make against that adversary.

mastery.name: Nemesis
mastery.text: **Spend 2 {{term:hope|Hope}}** to _Prioritize_ an adversary until your next rest. When you make an attack against your _Prioritized_ adversary, you can swap the results of your {{term:hope|Hope}} and {{term:fear|Fear}} Dice. You can only _Prioritize_ one adversary at a time.

name: Beastbound
text: Play the Beastbound if you want to form a deep bond with an animal ally.

foundation.name: Companion
foundation.text:
You have an animal companion of your choice (at the GM’s discretion). They stay by your side unless you tell them otherwise.

Take the Ranger Companion sheet. When you level up your character, choose a level-up option for your companion from this sheet as well.

specialization.name: Expert Training
specialization.text: Choose an additional level-up option for your companion.

specialization.name: Battle-Bonded
specialization.text: When an adversary attacks you while they’re within your companion’s {{term:melee|Melee range}}, you gain a +2 bonus to your {{term:evasion|Evasion}} against the attack.

mastery.name: Advanced Training
mastery.text: Choose two additional level-up options for your companion.

mastery.name: Loyal Friend
mastery.text: Once per {{term:long-rest|long rest}}, when the damage from an attack would mark your companion’s last {{term:stress|Stress}} or your last {{term:hit-points|Hit Point}} and you’re within {{term:close|Close range}} of each other, you or your companion can rush to the other’s side and take that damage instead.

name: Wayfinder
text: Play the Wayfinder if you want to hunt your prey and strike with deadly force.

foundation.name: Ruthless Predator
foundation.text: When you make a damage roll, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to gain a +1 bonus to your {{term:proficiency|Proficiency}}. Additionally, when you deal {{term:damage-thresholds|Severe damage}} to an adversary, they must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

foundation.name: Path Forward
foundation.text: When you’re traveling to a place you’ve previously visited or you carry an object that has been at the location before, you can identify the shortest, most direct path to your destination.

specialization.name: Elusive Predator
specialization.text: When your Focus makes an attack against you, you gain a +2 bonus to your {{term:evasion|Evasion}} against the attack.

mastery.name: Apex Predator
mastery.text: Before you make an attack roll against your _Focus_, you can **spend a {{term:hope|Hope}}.** On a successful attack, you remove a {{term:fear|Fear}} from the GM’s {{term:fear|Fear}} pool.

name: Nightwalker
text: Play the Nightwalker if you want to manipulate shadows to maneuver through the environment.

foundation.name: Shadow Stepper
foundation.text: You can move from shadow to shadow. When you move into an area of darkness or a shadow cast by another creature or object, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to disappear from where you are and reappear inside another shadow within {{term:far|Far range}}. When you reappear, you are _Cloaked._

specialization.name: Dark Cloud
specialization.text: Make a **{{term:spellcast-roll|Spellcast Roll}} (15).** On a success, create a {{term:temporary|temporary}} dark cloud that covers any area within {{term:close|Close range}}. Anyone in this cloud can’t see outside of it, and anyone outside of it can’t see in. You’re considered _Cloaked_ from any adversary for whom the cloud blocks line of sight.

specialization.name: Adrenaline
specialization.text: While you're _{{term:vulnerable|Vulnerable}},_ add your level to your damage rolls.

mastery.name: Fleeting Shadow
mastery.text: Gain a permanent +1 bonus to your {{term:evasion|Evasion}}. You can use your “Shadow Stepper” feature to move within {{term:very-far|Very Far range}}.

mastery.name: Vanishing Act
mastery.text: **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to become _Cloaked_ at any time. When _Cloaked_ from this feature, you automatically clear the _{{term:restrained|Restrained}}_ condition if you have it. You remain _Cloaked_ in this way until you roll with {{term:fear|Fear}} or until your next rest.

name: Syndicate
text: Play the Syndicate if you want to have a web of contacts everywhere you go.

foundation.name: Well-Connected
foundation.text:
When you arrive in a prominent town or environment, you know somebody who calls this place home. Give them a name, note how you think they could be useful, and choose one fact from the following list:

- They owe me a favor, but they’ll be hard to find.
- They’re going to ask for something in exchange.
- They’re always in a great deal of trouble.
- We used to be together. It’s a long story.
- We didn’t part on great terms.

specialization.name: Contacts Everywhere
specialization.text:
Once per session, you can briefly call on a shady contact. Choose one of the following benefits and describe what brought them here to help you in this moment:

- They provide 1 handful of gold, a unique tool, or a mundane object that the situation requires.
- On your next {{term:action-roll|action roll}}, their help provides a +3 bonus to the result of your {{term:hope|Hope}} or {{term:duality-dice|Fear Die}}.
- The next time you deal damage, they snipe from the shadows, adding **2d8** to your damage roll.

mastery.name: Reliable Backup
mastery.text:
You can use your “Contacts Everywhere” feature three times per session. The following options are added to the list of benefits you can choose from when you use that feature:

- When you mark 1 or more {{term:hit-points|Hit Points}}, they can rush out to shield you, reducing the {{term:hit-points|Hit Points}} marked by 1.
- When you make a {{term:presence|Presence}} Roll in conversation, they back you up. You can roll a **d20** as your {{term:duality-dice|Hope Die}}.

name: Divine Wielder
text: Play the Divine Wielder if you want to dominate the battlefield with a legendary weapon.

foundation.name: Spirit Weapon
foundation.text: When you have an equipped weapon with a range of Melee or Very Close, it can fly from your hand to attack an adversary within {{term:close|Close range}} and then return to you. You can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to target an additional adversary within range with the same attack roll.

foundation.name: Sparing Touch
foundation.text: Once per {{term:long-rest|long rest}}, touch a creature and clear 2 {{term:hit-points|Hit Points}} or 2 {{term:stress|Stress}} from them.

specialization.name: Devout
specialization.text: When you roll your Prayer Dice, you can roll an additional die and discard the lowest result. Additionally, you can use your “Sparing Touch” feature twice instead of once per {{term:long-rest|long rest}}.

mastery.name: Sacred Resonance
mastery.text: When you roll damage for your “Spirit Weapon” feature, if any of the die results match, double the value of each matching die. For example, if you roll two 5s, they count as two 10s.

name: Winged Sentinel
text: Play the Winged Sentinel if you want to take flight and strike crushing blows from the sky.

foundation.name: Wings of Light
foundation.text:
You can fly. While flying, you can do the following:

- **Mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to pick up and carry another willing creature approximately your size or smaller.
- **Spend a {{term:hope|Hope}}** to deal an extra **1d8** damage on a successful attack.

specialization.name: Ethereal Visage
specialization.text: Your supernatural visage strikes awe and fear. While flying, you have {{term:advantage|advantage}} on {{term:presence|Presence}} Rolls. When you succeed with {{term:hope|Hope}} on a {{term:presence|Presence}} Roll, you can remove a {{term:fear|Fear}} from the GM’s {{term:fear|Fear}} pool instead of gaining {{term:hope|Hope}}.

mastery.name: Ascendant
mastery.text: Gain a permanent +4 bonus to your {{term:damage-thresholds|Severe damage}} threshold.

mastery.name: Power of the Gods
mastery.text: While flying, you deal an extra **1d12** damage instead of 1d8 from your “Wings of Light” feature.

name: Elemental Origin
text: Play the Elemental Origin if you want to channel raw magic to take the shape of a particular element.

foundation.name: Elementalist
foundation.text:
Choose one of the following elements at character creation: air, earth, fire, lightning, water.

You can shape this element into harmless effects. Additionally, **spend a {{term:hope|Hope}}** and describe how your control over this element helps an {{term:action-roll|action roll}} you’re about to make, then either gain a +2 bonus to the roll or a +3 bonus to the roll’s damage.

specialization.name: Natural Evasion
specialization.text: You can call forth your element to protect you from harm. When an attack roll against you succeeds, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** and describe how you use your element to defend you. When you do, roll a **d6** and add its result to your {{term:evasion|Evasion}} against the attack.

mastery.name: Transcendence

name: Primal Origin
text: Play the Primal Origin if you want to extend the versatility of your spells in powerful ways.

foundation.name: Manipulate Magic
foundation.text:
Your primal origin allows you to modify the essence of magic itself. After you cast a spell or make an attack using a weapon that deals magic damage, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to do one of the following:

- Extend the spell or attack’s reach by one range
- Gain a +2 bonus to the {{term:action-roll|action roll}}’s result
- Double a damage die of your choice
- Hit an additional target within range

specialization.name: Enchanted Aid
specialization.text: You can enhance the magic of others with your essence. When you {{term:help-an-ally|Help an Ally}} with a {{term:spellcast-roll|Spellcast Roll}}, you can roll a **d8** as your {{term:advantage|advantage}} die. Once per {{term:long-rest|long rest}}, after an ally has made a {{term:spellcast-roll|Spellcast Roll}} with your help, you can swap the results of their {{term:duality-dice|Duality Dice}}.

mastery.name: Arcane Charge
mastery.text: You can gather magical energy to enhance your capabilities. When you take magic damage, you become _Charged_. Alternatively, you can **spend 2 {{term:hope|Hope}}** to become _Charged_. When you successfully make an attack that deals magic damage while _Charged_, you can clear your _Charge_ to either gain a +10 bonus to the damage roll or gain a +3 bonus to the {{term:difficulty|Difficulty}} of a {{term:reaction-roll|reaction roll}} the spell causes the target to make. You stop being _Charged_ at your next {{term:long-rest|long rest}}.

name: Pact of the Endless
text: Play the Pact of the Endless if you want to stand strong against enemies and avoid death.

foundation.name: Patron’s Mantle
foundation.text: **Spend a Favor** to cloak yourself in a terrifying aspect of your Patron that lasts until you take {{term:damage-thresholds|Severe damage}} or the scene ends. While this effect is active, you gain a bonus to your {{term:damage-thresholds|damage thresholds}} equal to your {{term:tier|tier}} and have {{term:advantage|advantage}} on {{term:action-roll|action rolls}} to intimidate a target.

foundation.name: Deathless Embrace
foundation.text: Once per rest, **spend any number** **of Favor** to roll an equal number of Patron Dice. For each result of 4 or higher, clear a {{term:hit-points|Hit Point}}.

specialization.name: Harrowing Invocation
specialization.text: When an adversary targets you or an ally within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} with an attack, you can **spend a Favor** to give them {{term:disadvantage|disadvantage}} on the roll. If the adversary fails the roll, they must also mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

specialization.name: Damage Sink
specialization.text: Once per rest, you can **spend a Favor** to halve {{term:incoming-damage|incoming damage}}.

mastery.name: Dark Aegis
mastery.text: Once per {{term:long-rest|long rest}} when you would take damage, you can **spend a Favor** instead of marking {{term:hit-points|Hit Points}}.

mastery.name: Draining Bane
mastery.text: When an adversary targets you or an ally within {{term:very-close|Very Close range}} with an attack, you can **spend** **a Favor** to _Drain_ them. When you do, they must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}, and you can clear a {{term:stress|Stress}}. While _Drained_, the target uses a **d12** instead of a d20 for attack rolls (including for {{term:advantage|advantage}} or {{term:disadvantage|disadvantage}}) until they fail a roll.

name: Pact of the Wrathful
text: Play the Pact of the Wrathful if you want to destroy those who act against you.

foundation.name: Patron’s Fury
foundation.text: **Spend a Favor** to imbue your attacks with your Patron’s power until you deal {{term:damage-thresholds|Severe damage}} or the scene ends. When you roll damage while this effect is active, you also roll a number of Patron Dice equal to your {{term:tier|tier}} and add their total to the damage dealt.

foundation.name: Deadly Vengeance
foundation.text: When you mark any number of {{term:hit-points|Hit Points}} from an attack, you can **spend a Favor** to roll an equal number of Patron Dice. For each result of 4 or higher, the attacker marks a {{term:hit-points|Hit Point}}.

specialization.name: Menacing Reach
specialization.text: **Spend a Favor** to increase the range of your primary weapon by one step (such as Melee to Very Close or Very Close to Close) to a maximum of {{term:very-far|Very Far range}}. This effect ends when you make a successful attack with that weapon.

specialization.name: Diminish My Foes
specialization.text: When you succeed with {{term:hope|Hope}} on an {{term:action-roll|action roll}} against a target, you can **spend any number** **of Favor** to force the target to mark an equal number of {{term:stress|Stress}}.

mastery.name: Fearsome Attack
mastery.text: **Spend a Favor** to reroll any number of your damage dice. You can continue spending Favor to use this feature on the same damage roll.

mastery.name: Otherworldly Ire
mastery.text: Once per rest when you take damage, you can **spend any number of Favor** to roll that many Patron Dice and target a number of creatures within {{term:close|Close range}} equal to the highest result. Each target must mark a {{term:hit-points|Hit Point}}.

name: Call of the Brave
text: Play the Call of the Brave if you want to use the might of your enemies to fuel your own power.

foundation.name: Courage
foundation.text: When you fail a roll with {{term:fear|Fear}}, you gain a {{term:hope|Hope}}.

foundation.name: Battle Ritual
foundation.text: Once per {{term:long-rest|long rest}}, before you attempt something incredibly dangerous or face off against a foe who clearly outmatches you, describe what ritual you perform or preparations you make. When you do, clear 2 {{term:stress|Stress}} and gain 2 {{term:hope|Hope}}.

specialization.name: Rise to the Challenge
specialization.text: You are vigilant in the face of mounting danger. While you have 2 or fewer {{term:hit-points|Hit Points}} unmarked, you can roll a **d20** as your {{term:duality-dice|Hope Die}}.

mastery.name: Camaraderie
mastery.text: Your unwavering bravery is a rallying point for your allies. You can initiate a {{term:tag-team-roll|Tag Team Roll}} one additional time per session. Additionally, when an ally initiates a {{term:tag-team-roll|Tag Team Roll}} with you, they only need to spend 2 {{term:hope|Hope}} to do so.

name: Call of the Slayer
text: Play the Call of the Slayer if you want to strike down adversaries with immense force.

foundation.name: Slayer
foundation.text: You gain a pool of dice called Slayer Dice. On a roll with {{term:hope|Hope}}, you can place a **d6** on this card instead of gaining a {{term:hope|Hope}}, adding the die to the pool. You can store a number of Slayer Dice equal to your {{term:proficiency|Proficiency}}. When you make an attack roll or damage roll, you can spend any number of these Slayer Dice, rolling them and adding their result to the roll. At the end of each session, clear any unspent Slayer Dice on this card and gain a {{term:hope|Hope}} per die cleared.

specialization.name: Weapon Specialist
specialization.text: You can wield multiple weapons with dangerous ease. When you succeed on an attack, you can **spend a {{term:hope|Hope}}** to add one of the damage dice from your secondary weapon to the damage roll. Additionally, once per {{term:long-rest|long rest}} when you roll your Slayer Dice, reroll any 1s.

mastery.name: Martial Preparation
mastery.text: You’re an inspirational warrior to all who travel with you. Your party gains access to the Martial Preparation {{term:downtime|downtime move}}. To use this move during a rest, describe how you instruct and train with your party. You and each ally who chooses this {{term:downtime|downtime move}} gain a **d6** Slayer Die. A PC with a Slayer Die can spend it to roll the die and add the result to an attack or damage roll of their choice.

name: Hedge
text: Play the Hedge if you want to use your craft to empower yourself and your party.

foundation.name: Herbal Remedies
foundation.text: When you or an ally in the scene clears 1 or more {{term:hit-points|Hit Points}} or {{term:stress|Stress}} as the result of using a consumable, increase the number cleared by 1.

foundation.name: Enchanted Talisman
foundation.text: Once per rest, you can imbue a small item with your protective essence. **Spend any number** **of {{term:hope|Hope}}** to place an equal number of tokens on this card. When the person holding the talisman takes damage, spend a token to reduce the number of {{term:hit-points|Hit Points}} they mark by one. Clear all tokens from this card when you take a rest.

specialization.name: Walk Between Worlds
specialization.text: During a moment of calm, make a **{{term:spellcast-roll|Spellcast Roll}} (13)**. Once per rest on a success, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to step beyond the veil of death and converse with any nearby spirits. Place a number of tokens equal to your {{term:spellcast-trait|Spellcast trait}} on this card and remove one each time a spirit answers a question. When the last token is removed or at the end of the scene, you return to the Mortal Realm in the same spot you left it.

specialization.name: Vexing Malison
specialization.text: You have {{term:advantage|advantage}} on attacks against _Hexed_ creatures.

mastery.name: Circle of Power
mastery.text: Once per rest, mark a circle on the ground outlining a Very Close area around you, and place a number of tokens equal to your {{term:spellcast-trait|Spellcast trait}} on this card. While within this circle, you and your allies gain a +2 bonus to {{term:damage-thresholds|damage thresholds}}, attack rolls, and {{term:evasion|Evasion}}. Remove a token each time you or an ally within the circle makes an {{term:action-roll|action roll}} or evades an attack. This spell lasts until the last token is removed or you exit the circle.

name: Moon
text: Play the Moon if you want to embody celestial power to amplify your magic.

foundation.name: Night’s Glamour
foundation.text:
Make a **{{term:spellcast-roll|Spellcast Roll}} (13)** to _Glamour_ yourself in a bewitching facade. While _Glamoured_, you have {{term:advantage|advantage}} on rolls that leverage your illusory appearance. Additionally, adversaries within {{term:close|Close range}} must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}} to attack you.

Unless you **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** to maintain your _Glamour_, it drops when you mark a {{term:hit-points|Hit Point}} or deal damage.

specialization.name: Moonbeam
specialization.text: Once per session, you can conjure a column of moonlight that illuminates the area within {{term:close|Close range}} until the end of the scene. While bathed in this moonlight, you and your allies gain a +1 bonus to {{term:spellcast-roll|Spellcast Rolls}} and can see through illusions.

specialization.name: Ire of Pale Light
specialization.text: When a _Hexed_ creature within {{term:very-far|Very Far range}} fails an attack, they must mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}.

mastery.name: Lunar Phases
mastery.text:
At the beginning of each session, roll a **d6** and place it on this card. You gain the matching effect until the end of session.

Roll Phase Effect

**1** New **Spend a {{term:hope|Hope}}** to negate {{term:damage-thresholds|Minor damage}}.

**2–3** Waxing +2 to damage rolls

**4** Full +3 to {{term:damage-thresholds|damage thresholds}}

**5–6** Waning +1 to {{term:evasion|Evasion}}

Once per rest, you can **spend a {{term:hope|Hope}}** to increase the value of this die by one. If you increase the value of a 6, it becomes a 1.

name: School of Knowledge
text: Play the School of {{term:knowledge|Knowledge}} if you want a keen understanding of the world around you.

foundation.name: Prepared
foundation.text: Take an additional {{term:domain-card|domain card}} of your level or lower from a domain you have access to.

foundation.name: Adept
foundation.text: When you Utilize an {{term:experience|Experience}}, you can **mark a** **{{term:stress|Stress}}** instead of spending a {{term:hope|Hope}}. If you do, double your {{term:experience|Experience}} modifier for that roll.

specialization.name: Accomplished
specialization.text: Take an additional {{term:domain-card|domain card}} of your level or lower from a domain you have access to.

specialization.name: Perfect Recall
specialization.text: Once per rest, when you recall a {{term:domain-card|domain card}} in your {{term:vault|vault}}, you can reduce its {{term:recall-cost|Recall Cost}} by 1.

mastery.name: Brilliant
mastery.text: Take an additional {{term:domain-card|domain card}} of your level or lower from a domain you have access to.

mastery.name: Honed Expertise
mastery.text: When you use an {{term:experience|Experience}}, roll a **d6.** On a result of 5 or higher, you can use it without spending {{term:hope|Hope}}.

name: School of War
text: Play the School of War if you want to utilize trained magic for violence.

foundation.name: Battlemage
foundation.text: You’ve focused your studies on becoming an unconquerable force on the battlefield. Gain an additional {{term:hit-points|Hit Point}} slot.

foundation.name: Face Your Fear
foundation.text: When you succeed with {{term:fear|Fear}} on an attack roll, you deal an extra **1d10** magic damage.

specialization.name: Conjure Shield
specialization.text: You can maintain a protective barrier of magic. While you have at least 2 {{term:hope|Hope}}, you add your {{term:proficiency|Proficiency}} to your {{term:evasion|Evasion}}.

specialization.name: Fueled by Fear
specialization.text: The extra magic damage from your “Face Your {{term:fear|Fear}}” feature increases to **2d10**.

mastery.name: Thrive in Chaos
mastery.text: When you succeed on an attack, you can **mark a {{term:stress|Stress}}** after rolling damage to force the target to mark an additional {{term:hit-points|Hit Point}}.

mastery.name: Have No Fear
mastery.text: The extra magic damage from your “Face Your {{term:fear|Fear}}” feature increases to **3d10.**
